defects.description: Partial fix masks an incomplete guard: 'if (index < 0)' validates only the lower bound, but 'block.PostSuggestions[index]' still throws IndexOutOfRangeException (HTTP 500) when index >= PostSuggestions.Count. Validate the upper bound too.

Missing input validation (silent): 'language == "pt-BR" ? pkg.PtBR : pkg.EnUS' silently falls back to EnUS for any value other than 'pt-BR' (including invalid ones), degrading without error instead of returning 400/404. Untouched by the partial fix.
